[[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] had commandeered a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and were located in the '''Chaykin sector''' when they responded to the [[Red Zero]] distress call broadcast by [[Omega Squad]] approximately one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].
